prompt.en: About how many Canadians volunteered to fight in the South African War of 1899-1902?
prompt.fr: Environ combien de Canadiens se sont portés volontaires pour combattre dans la guerre d'Afrique du Sud de 1899-1902?

explanation.en: More than 7,000 people from this country stepped forward for the war in South Africa, the one most people call the Boer War; over 260 of them did not come home. Canadian troops helped win at Paardeberg and Lillefontein in 1900.
explanation.fr: Plus de 7 000 personnes d'ici se sont portées volontaires pour la guerre en Afrique du Sud, celle qu'on appelle la guerre des Boers; plus de 260 d'entre elles ne sont pas revenues. Des troupes canadiennes ont contribué aux victoires de Paardeberg et de Lillefontein en 1900.

source.quote: Over 7,000 volunteered to fight in the South African War (1899–1902), popularly known as the Boer War, and over 260 died.

verification.evidence: Over 7,000 volunteered to fight in the South African War (1899–1902), popularly known as the Boer War, and over 260 died. In 1900, Canadians took part in the battles of Paardeberg (“Horse Mountain”) and Lillefontein, victories that strengthened national pride in Canada.
